root_cause.text: The error handling paths in gfs2_fill_super and gfs2_make_fs_rw fail to clean up kernel threads (logd/quotad) and quota bitmap allocations when transitioning from read-only to read-write mode fails after partial initialization, leading to memory leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `gfs2_destroy_threads()` from a specific error branch to the `fail_per_node` label to ensure threads are destroyed on all error paths after `init_threads()` succeeds, and adds `gfs2_quota_cleanup()` inside `gfs2_make_fs_rw()` when the filesystem is withdrawn after `gfs2_quota_init()` succeeds but before the function completes, as shown in the diff and described in the commit message and CVE description.
